title: Selfless nonnuclear crossed products
summary: For a strictly ergodic action of a countable discrete group with Ozawa's property PHP on the Cantor set, we prove that dynamical comparison implies complete selflessness of its reduced crossed product. Therefore these crossed products have stable rank one, strict comparison, a unique quasitracial state, and real rank zero. Applications include probability-measure-preserving Cantor actions of C*-simple acylindrically hyperbolic and C*-simple linear groups for which an infinite amenable subgroup acts strictly ergodically.
